desc:
⚠️ PENGLUKATAN ⚠️

A sacred purification ritual that was meant to bring peace... has turned into an unexplainable nightmare.

Enter a remote village filled with dark secrets, mysterious whispers, and terrifying forces lurking in the shadows. As you uncover the truth behind the Penglukatan ritual, you will face supernatural entities, solve chilling mysteries, and experience events that defy all logic.

🔦 Explore haunted locations with a terrifying atmosphere
👻 Survive encounters with relentless supernatural entities
🧩 Uncover the mysteries and secrets of a forbidden ritual
🎧 Recommended to play with sound/headphones for the best experience
⚠️ Contains jumpscares and disturbing scenes

Dare to enter... but there's no guarantee you'll make it back out.
